seo.title: YNX Docs — Private, versioned documents with explicit collaboration control
seo.metaDescription: Create and edit versioned documents with offline recovery, permission controls, auditable exports and review-first AI assistance.
seo.h1: Documents that stay under your control

positioning: YNX Docs is an independent document editing and collaboration product. Document bodies remain in Cloud/Object Store; only necessary permission, version-hash, audit and settlement evidence may be recorded by accepted YNX services.
features: Version-aware autosave and explicit conflict recovery
Offline drafts with no silent overwrite
Rename, move and duplicate with permission isolation
Share grants, expiring links and revocation services
Text, Markdown, HTML and JSON export with source/output hashes
Review-first AI drafts limited to selected document versions
Audit and Trust evidence without document plaintext
Health, readiness, version and Prometheus metrics with request/trace/error correlation IDs
Offline operator backup and hash-verified restore with ephemeral credentials excluded
risksAndLimits: Current release status is local development, not a public Runtime.
PDF export is not currently claimed.
Shared Testnet, central integration, hosted downloads and production signing are not yet verified.
AI availability, provider, model and cost depend on accepted AI Gateway status; no result is applied without user review.
Document bodies are not claimed to be stored on-chain.

faq.question: Does YNX Docs store document text on-chain?
faq.answer: No. Document bodies and versions are designed for Cloud/Object Store. Accepted YNX services may retain permission, version-hash, audit or settlement evidence without document plaintext.

faq.question: What happens when two devices edit the same document?
faq.answer: YNX Docs compares the client's base version with the current server version. A mismatch opens explicit conflict recovery instead of silently overwriting either edit.

faq.question: Can AI read every file in my Drive?
faq.answer: No. Docs AI requests are limited to document versions the user explicitly selects and consents to send. Results remain drafts until approved or rejected.

faq.question: Which export formats are available?
faq.answer: The current local runtime supports Text, Markdown, HTML and JSON exports with source and output hash evidence. PDF is not yet claimed.

faq.question: Is YNX Docs publicly available now?
faq.answer: No. The product is implemented and tested locally, but central integration, public deployment, hosted downloads and production signing are not yet verified.

websiteIntegration.instructions: Publish only after validating this file and retaining the distinction between the Website page and the Docs Runtime. Do not synthesize download links or public deployment claims.
